page.title: Connectors
page.intro: Batanidza maakaundi ako ekushambadza. Inotungamira kubva kumashambadziro ako inosvika muMy Leads otomatiki, nekushandisa uye mutengo wekutungamira.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form inotungamira muKutungamira Kwangu, mari yemazuva ese uye mutengo pane inotungamira, uye inotungamira mhando inodzoserwa LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn yakabatana. Zvinotungamira zviri kutorwa izvozvi - peji ino inovandudzwa nechinguva chidiki.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn haisati yamiswa pane iyi server parizvino. Administrator anofanira kuwedzera LinkedIn app's client ID uye chakavanzika.
banner.expired: Iyo LinkedIn yekubatanidza yapera, saka madhiri haasi kuwiriranisa. Batanidza zvakare kuti uenderere mberi.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn inoda kuti upinde zvakare pa {{date}} . Batanidza zvakare zvisati zvaitika kuti nhanho dzirambe dzichiyerera.

connect.title: Batanidza LinkedIn
connect.intro: Saina neiyo LinkedIn account inodzora ads yako. Leadrat inongoverenga ako ad account, Lead Gen Form inotungamira uye ad statistics, uye inotumira shanduko yaunobatidza.
connect.need1: Basa pane LinkedIn ad account (Muoni kana pamusoro).
connect.need2: Basa riri papeji yekambani yakabatanidzwa (Mutungamiriri, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator kana Analyst) - LinkedIn inoda kuti igovane vatungamiri.
connect.need3: Mubvunzo wenhamba dzerunhare pane yako Lead Gen Forms - inotungamira isina nhamba yefoni haigone kuwedzerwa.

connection.noPermission: Unogona kuona peji rino. Kubatanidza uye kuchinja marongero kunoda mvumo ye "Manage Settings".
connection.fetchHint: Mitsva mitsva inotariswa maminetsi mashoma uye mazuva ekupedzisira e7 anoongororwazve zuva rega rega, saka hapana chinopotsa. Shandisa izvi kune zvinotungamira kubva usati wabatana, kana kutarisa nguva zvakare (kusvika kumazuva makumi mapfumbamwe panguva). Inotungamira yatove Leadrat inosvetuka.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Udza LinkedIn kuti ndeupi wekutungamira kwayo wakave tarisiro chaiyo. Kana LinkedIn inotungamira ichisvika pachimiro chaunosarudza pazasi, Leadrat inoshuma LinkedIn , saka mishumo yako yemushandirapamwe inoratidza hutungamiriri hwemhando uye LinkedIn inogona kuwana vanhu vakawanda sevanotungamira vako. Iyo chete LinkedIn inotungamira ID uye imwe-nzira hashi ye email inotumirwa.

activity.intro: Zvese zviri pakati Leadrat LinkedIn : zvinongedzo, kuwiriranisa kwese, kutungamira kwese uye zvakaitika kwairi, shanduko uye kukanganisa.
